title: Field Guide: Relative Time & Weekly Planning

words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我是前天晚上到北京的。(Wǒ shì qiántiān wǎnshang dào Běijīng de.) — I arrived in Beijing the night before yesterday.
后天上午我们有一场考试。(Hòutiān shàngwǔ wǒmen yǒu yì chǎng kǎoshì.) — We have an exam the morning after tomorrow.
上个星期我去了上海出差。(Shàng ge xīngqī wǒ qù le Shànghǎi chūchāi.) — Last week I went on a business trip to Shanghai.
下个星期我们去看电影吧。(Xià ge xīngqī wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng ba.) — Let's go watch a movie next week.
上个月天气特别热。(Shàng ge yuè tiānqì tèbié rè.) — Last month the weather was especially hot.
下个月姐姐要来北京看我。(Xià ge yuè jiějie yào lái Běijīng kàn wǒ.) — Next month my elder sister will visit me in Beijing.
我是前年开始学中文的。(Wǒ shì qiánnián kāishǐ xué zhōngwén de.) — I started learning Chinese the year before last.
他打算后年大学毕业。(Tā dǎsuàn hòunián dàxué bìyè.) — He plans to graduate from university the year after next.
你平时几点下班？(Nǐ píngshí jǐ diǎn xiàbān?) — What time do you normally get off work?
我以前在伦敦住过两年。(Wǒ yǐqián zài Lúndūn zhù guo liǎng nián.) — I lived in London for two years previously.
吃完饭以后我们去散步。(Chī wán fàn yǐhòu wǒmen qù sànbù.) — After finishing the meal we'll go for a walk.
我平时做饭，有时候点外卖。(Wǒ píngshí zuòfàn, yǒu shíhou diǎn wàimài.) — I usually cook, sometimes order takeout.
你今天晚上有空吗？(Nǐ jīntiān wǎnshang yǒu kòng ma?) — Are you free tonight?
真不好意思，我明天一整天都没空。(Zhēn bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ míngtiān yì zhěng tiān dōu méi kòng.) — Really sorry, I have no free time all day tomorrow.
今天太匆忙了，改天再聚吧！(Jīntiān tài cōngmáng le, gǎitiān zài jù ba!) — Today is too rushed, let's meet another day!
我们需要提前半小时到达车站。(Wǒmen xūyào tíqián bàn xiǎoshí dàodá chēzhàn.) — We need to arrive at the station half an hour early.
因为下雨，活动推迟到下周。(Yīnwèi xiàyǔ, huódòng tuīchí dào xià zhōu.) — Due to rain, the event is postponed until next week.
我马上就到楼下了。(Wǒ mǎshàng jiù dào lóuxià le.) — I'll be downstairs immediately.
我刚从超市买菜回来。(Wǒ gāng cóng chāoshì mǎi cài huílái.) — I just returned from grocery shopping at the supermarket.
火车已经进站了。(Huǒchē yǐjīng jìnzhàn le.) — The train has already entered the station.

words.English Meaning: a short while / in a moment
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我休息一会儿就继续写作业。(Wǒ xiūxi yíhuìr jiù jìxù xiě zuòyè.) — I'll rest a moment then continue homework.
我稍后给您回电话。(Wǒ shāohòu gěi nín huí diànhuà.) — I will call you back shortly.
汽车需要定期保养。(Qìchē xūyào dìngqī bǎoyǎng.) — Cars need regular maintenance.
